A '''female chef''' personally served [[Darth Nyriss]], a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|member]] of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] [[Dark Council]]. During an assassination attempt on Nyriss by a programmed [[Droid/Legends|droid]], the chef was [[Death/Legends|killed]] instead.<ref name="Revan" />
